definitions.explanation: Containing poison or producing harmful effects on living organisms. Used in chemistry, biology, medicine, environmental science, and food-safety contexts to describe substances, gases, plants, and animals that can injure or kill. A neutral scientific/formal term — not metaphorical ('toxic' relationship, 'toxic' behavior). Functions as both a na-adjective and a no-adjective; also very common as a prefix in compound nouns: {有毒|ゆうどく}ガス ('toxic gas').

examples.japanese: {有毒|ゆうどく}な{植物|しょくぶつ}。
この{魚|さかな}の{内臓|ないぞう}には{有毒|ゆうどく}な{成分|せいぶん}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: The internal organs of this fish contain toxic substances.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}から{漏|も}れた{有毒|ゆうどく}ガスで{周辺|しゅうへん}{住民|じゅうみん}が{避難|ひなん}した。
examples.english: Residents in the area evacuated due to toxic gas that leaked from the factory.

examples.japanese: {野生|やせい}のキノコには{食用|しょくよう}のものと{有毒|ゆうどく}なものがあるので、{素人|しろうと}{判断|はんだん}は{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: Some wild mushrooms are edible and others are poisonous, so amateur judgment is dangerous.

notes:
Compound of {有|ゆう} ('having; possessing') and {毒|どく} ('poison'), literally 'having poison'. Pattern {有|ゆう}- vs {無|む}- ('not having') produces matched antonyms: {有毒|ゆうどく} / {無毒|むどく}, {有害|ゆうがい} / {無害|むがい}, {有料|ゆうりょう} / {無料|むりょう}.

USAGE:
- As a na-adjective before nouns: {有毒|ゆうどく}な{植物|しょくぶつ} ('poisonous plant'), {有毒|ゆうどく}な{物質|ぶっしつ} ('toxic substance').
- As a prefix in compound nouns without な: {有毒|ゆうどく}ガス, {有毒|ゆうどく}{物質|ぶっしつ}, {有毒|ゆうどく}{成分|せいぶん}.
- Used literally, not metaphorically. For emotionally/socially harmful situations Japanese usually prefers {有害|ゆうがい} ('harmful') or borrows トキシック.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有毒|ゆうどく}ガス: toxic gas
- {有毒|ゆうどく}{物質|ぶっしつ}: toxic substance
- {有毒|ゆうどく}{成分|せいぶん}: toxic component
- {有毒|ゆうどく}{植物|しょくぶつ}: poisonous plant
- {有毒|ゆうどく}{生物|せいぶつ}: venomous/poisonous creature
- {有毒|ゆうどく}{廃棄|はいき}{物|ぶつ}: toxic waste
- {有毒|ゆうどく}{煙|けむり}: toxic smoke/fumes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有害|ゆうがい}: harmful — broader; covers anything damaging to health or society (pollution, bad influence), not only poisons.
- {毒性|どくせい}: toxicity — the noun describing the property; {毒性|どくせい}が{強|つよ}い ('highly toxic').
- {猛毒|もうどく}: deadly poison — an intensified noun; a step up from {有毒|ゆうどく}.
- {無毒|むどく}: non-toxic; harmless
